gloss_en: a terrorist organization formed in the 1960s by children of Iranian merchants; sought to counter the Shah of Iran's pro-western policies of modernization and opposition to communism; following a philosophy that mixes Marxism and Islam it now attacks the Islamic fundamentalists who deposed the Shah
senses_vi: Tổ chức MKO (tổ chức khủng bố đối lập Iran, pha trộn chủ nghĩa Mác và Hồi giáo)
